source.snippet: I am searching for something to make wireframing convenient. Consider the difference in speed between creating a diagram in Inkscape or HTML, versus MermaidJS. [Cross-posted references to multiple reddit threads seeking same solution, score 2, active search across platforms]

problem_statement: Developers and designers want a text/markup-based wireframing tool analogous to MermaidJS for diagrams — current GUI tools like Figma or Inkscape are too slow for rapid ideation and developers prefer code-first workflows.
target_segment: Software developers, UX designers, and technical product managers who prefer code-driven workflows and need fast, version-controllable wireframing.
notes: User cross-posted to multiple reddit threads and SE, indicating active unsatisfied search. Existing tools: Wireframe.cc, Excalidraw, Penpot — but none offer a MermaidJS-style DSL. Developer segment pays for tools (e.g., Figma at $12-45/mo). Weak on explicit WTP evidence but cross-platform active search raises confidence slightly.
